summary: Comprehensive testing of new Plume Astrale features completed. Backend: 20/20 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All new pages working correctly (Quotidien, Tarot Oui/Non, Tarologie). PDF preview on /apercu page working. Navbar shows new links. All new API endpoints functional.
passed_tests: GET /api/daily/{sign} - Returns daily horoscope for all 12 zodiac signs
POST /api/tarot/oui-non - Returns card reading with oui/non/neutre orientation
POST /api/tarologie/tirage - Returns 7-card reading with mediumnite lecture
POST /api/pdf/preview - Returns 3 base64 preview images from 15-page PDF
POST /api/checkout/create for tarot_oui_non - Creates Stripe checkout session (4.99€)
POST /api/checkout/create for tarologie_mediumnite - Creates Stripe checkout session (35€)
GET /api/products - Returns all products including new ones with correct prices
POST /api/access/free with ASTRO100 - Grants free access
Frontend /quotidien - Sign picker grid with 12 signs, loads daily content on selection
Frontend /tarot-oui-non - Question form, card result display, orientation badge
Frontend /tarologie - Offer details (35€), form, preview tirage with locked cards
Frontend /apercu - PDF preview section shows 3 page images + remaining pages count
Frontend Navbar - Shows new links: Guidance du Jour, Tarot Oui/Non, Tarologie
Frontend formulaire -> apercu flow - 5-step form navigation working
critical_code_review_comments: All new API endpoints properly implemented with error handling
Daily content uses deterministic seeding for consistent daily results
Tarot services generate random but reproducible readings
PDF preview efficiently generates and caches preview images
Stripe integration works for new products (tarot_oui_non, tarologie_mediumnite)
Frontend components have proper data-testid attributes for testing
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - tests use provided test data (Marie, 1990-06-15, 14:30, Paris)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features from iteration 4 tested and working: 1) Daily content API (GET /api/daily/{sign}) works for all 12 zodiac signs, 2) Tarot Oui/Non API (POST /api/tarot/oui-non) returns card readings, 3) Tarologie API (POST /api/tarologie/tirage and /pdf) returns 7-card readings with PDF generation, 4) PDF preview (POST /api/pdf/preview) returns 3 base64 images, 5) New product checkouts work (tarot_oui_non at 4.99€, tarologie_mediumnite at 35€), 6) Frontend pages /quotidien, /tarot-oui-non, /tarologie all functional, 7) PDF preview visible on /apercu page, 8) Navbar shows new links. Test file: /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py
